using System;
using System.IO;
using System.IO.Compression;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.FullSystemBackup;
using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Implementations.Tests.FullSystemBackup
{
    public class BackupServiceTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<BackupService>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _mockApplicationPaths;
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationHost> _mockApplicationHost;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<Jellyfin.Database.JellyfinDbContext>> _mockDbProvider;
        private readonly Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider> _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider;
        private readonly Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime> _mockLifetime;

        public BackupServiceTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BackupService>>();
            _mockApplicationPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockApplicationHost = new Mock<IServerApplicationHost>();
            _mockDbProvider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<Jellyfin.Database.JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider = new Mock<IJellyfinDatabaseProvider>();
            _mockLifetime = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BackupService_LogsConfigurationDirectoryBackupInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var configPath = "/path/to/config";
            _mockApplicationPaths.Setup(p => p.ConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns(configPath);

            var backupService = new BackupService(
                _mockLogger.Object,
                _mockDbProvider.Object,
                _mockApplicationHost.Object,
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider.Object,
                _mockLifetime.Object);

            // Create mocks for other required dependencies to avoid null refs during execution
            var mockZipArchive = new Mock<ZipArchive>(new MemoryStream(), ZipArchiveMode.Create);
            mockZipArchive.Setup(a => a.CreateEntryFromFileAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>()));

            // Act - This would trigger the LogInformation call at line 373 during backup execution
            // We verify the logger was called with the expected message template and arguments
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    "Backup of folder {Table}",
                    configPath),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void BackupService_CopyDirectory_LogsFolderBackupInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var sourcePath = "/path/to/source";
            _mockApplicationPaths.Setup(p => p.ConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns("/path/to/config");

            var backupService = new BackupService(
                _mockLogger.Object,
                _mockDbProvider.Object,
                _mockApplicationHost.Object,
                _mockApplicationPaths.Object,
                _mockJellyfinDatabaseProvider.Object,
                _mockLifetime.Object);

            // Act & Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    "Backup of folder {Table}",
                    sourcePath),
                Times.Never); // Before calling CopyDirectory

            // Simulate the CopyDirectory call that would log the message
            backupService.GetType()
                .GetMethod("CopyDirectory", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                .Invoke(backupService, new object[] { sourcePath, "target", "*" });

            _mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogInformation(
                    "Backup of folder {Table}",
                    sourcePath),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
